description: This file provides utility methods for performing MongoDB operations such as dropping collections and deleting documents by filter, utilizing reactive streams with Akka and MongoDB Java driver.

classes.name: MongoOpsUtil
classes.description: Utility class for MongoDB persistence operations, providing methods for dropping collections and deleting documents by filter using reactive streams with Akka.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Returns a source that drops a MongoDB collection and emits a list of throwables if any occur.

methods.name: deleteByFilter
methods.description: Returns a source that deletes documents matching a filter from a MongoDB collection, emitting any errors encountered.

methods.name: doDrop
methods.description: Performs the actual drop operation on the collection, returning a source that emits an optional throwable.

methods.name: doDeleteByFilter
methods.description: Performs delete-many operation with a filter on the collection, returning a source that emits an optional throwable.
